answer: I am Team J's multilingual voice assistant, built at the Hack4Haldia 2026 hackathon. You speak in Hindi or Bengali, and I reply out loud in the same language. I can also type and speak Odia.
I understand spoken Hindi and Bengali, and typed Odia. I can speak back in Hindi, Bengali, Odia and English. Whisper has no Odia model, so Odia input is typed.
Speech recognition uses OpenAI Whisper large-v3, understanding and replies use Google Gemma 4 through the Gemini API, and the voice uses Meta MMS-TTS. All three are open-weight models.
You can attach a photo and ask a question about it. Gemma 4 is multimodal, so it looks at the picture and answers in your language.
This was built by Team J in three hours at the Hack4Haldia 2026 hackathon.
